mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_record WHERE goal_id = #{goalId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_record WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_record (user_id, goal_id, task_id, study_date, duration_minutes, content, reflection, focus_score) VALUES (#{userId}, #{goalId}, #{taskId}, #{studyDate}, #{durationMinutes}, #{content}, #{reflection}, #{focusScore})
mapper.update: UPDATE study_record SET user_id=#{userId}, goal_id=#{goalId}, task_id=#{taskId}, study_date=#{studyDate}, duration_minutes=#{durationMinutes}, content=#{content}, reflection=#{reflection}, focus_score=#{focusScore}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
